scripts.seed:legacy: cd apps/backend && pnpm run strapi import -f ../seed-data.tar.gz
scripts.export: cd apps/backend && pnpm run strapi export --no-encrypt -f ../seed-data
scripts.scan:backend: pnpm run build:backend && trivy image --exit-code 1 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL nextjs-strapiv4-cms/backend && kics scan -p apps/backend/Dockerfile --no-progress --fail-on critical
